svg.title: Projects and research
svg.desc: Agent hub: multi-agent orchestration: Manager agent, project supervisors and workers in isolated git worktrees. Test gates, cross-model review, human approval for irreversible actions.; Legal RAG over 21 Polish statutes: Every answer cites the provision and the legal-state date, or abstains. Hybrid retrieval, RRF and LLM reranking.; AAE: self-improving decision system: Hundreds of strategy variants; one is promoted only after sequential tests and online FDR control. The isolated executor is fail-closed.; Polish embedding model fine-tune: multilingual-e5-large-instruct on 7 Polish datasets: hard negatives from BM25 plus a cross-encoder, MNRL + Matryoshka loss.
